common_stages.name: Action Intake
common_stages.purpose: Capture requested action, destination, payload, cost/contract terms, platform, identity context, and intended outcome.

common_stages.name: Eligibility Review
common_stages.purpose: Confirm the action is in the approval-gated allowlist and not in the hard-blocked list.

common_stages.name: Platform Terms Review
common_stages.purpose: Confirm the selected method is permitted by platform terms, official API rules, or explicit authorization.

common_stages.name: Truthfulness Review
common_stages.purpose: Confirm no fabricated credentials, false identity claims, fake completion states, fake portfolio claims, or deceptive statements are present.

common_stages.name: Credential and Secret Review
common_stages.purpose: Confirm credentials are not used unless a reviewed integration, secret broker, least-privilege scope, audit log, and revocation plan exist.

common_stages.name: Operator Popup Review
common_stages.purpose: Show exact action, exact destination, exact payload, risk class, terms, cost, and rollback/correction plan in a local popup.

common_stages.name: Operator Proceed Decision
common_stages.purpose: Require the operator to click Proceed. Cancel or missing approval leaves action blocked.

common_stages.name: Execution Handoff
common_stages.purpose: Execute only through a future reviewed connector or manual operator handoff. This procedure packet itself never performs external action.

common_stages.name: Audit Receipt
common_stages.purpose: Record request, decision, payload hash, destination, risk class, timestamp, operator confirmation state, and external_action_performed flag.

common_stages.name: Post-Action Review
common_stages.purpose: Confirm outcome, error state, rollback/correction needs, and lessons learned.

high_risk_extra_stages.name: Financial Risk Review
high_risk_extra_stages.purpose: Display exact money, obligation, term, recipient, platform, and spending/contract risk before Proceed can be enabled.

high_risk_extra_stages.name: Deployment Risk Review
high_risk_extra_stages.purpose: Show tests, diff, target, rollback plan, owner authorization, and blast-radius notes before Proceed can be enabled.

high_risk_extra_stages.name: Delivery Quality Review
high_risk_extra_stages.purpose: Show deliverable, evidence packet, acceptance criteria, quality gate status, and operator review state before Proceed can be enabled.

evidence_requirements: cost or contract obligations when applicable
audit_requirements: external_action_performed=false unless future connector executes after approval
